items.html: And we shall first explain the first aspect, which is to push ZA out, and it is as follows: for behold, now there are many lights in the full belly, which is Tvuna, both her own lights and the lights of ZON. And all of them are in that place of the vessel which is the place of pregnancy, which is in the belly, in the lower third of the Tifferet of Tvuna, as above.
